items.title: DuckDuckGo launches no-AI search extensions after users reject Google's AI-first Search - TweakTown
items.summary: # DuckDuckGo launches no-AI search extensions after users reject Google's AI-first Search. ## Traffic to DuckDuckGo's no-AI search page tripled after Google's overhaul, and the company is now making it even easier to ditch AI search entirely. **TL;DR:** Following Google's major AI-driven Search update, many users have shifted to DuckDuckGo, whose no-AI search traffic tripled and app installs surged. However, a significant number of users have pushed back against the **AI-heavy** direction and, in the process, many have ended up at DuckDuckGo. Traffic to DuckDuckGo's No AI search page tripled after Google's announcement and has continued to surge. To keep the momentum going, the company has now launched new browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox that let users set its AI-free search page, noai.duckduckgo.com, as their default search engine. From there, the Duck.ai chatbot can be disabled entirely, and the app can be set to open with a plain search interface by default every time.

items.title: Telstra elevates Dayle Stevens to company-wide AI role - iTnews
items.summary: ## Telstra elevates Dayle Stevens to company-wide AI role ## Cbus Super Fund's Group head of technology departs ## HBF faces AI agent to members for first time ## Microsoft backs down on legal threats against 0day disclosing researchers ## The hidden economics of AI: Why token usage matters more than you think. Telstra has elevated Dayle Stevens to a newly created enterprise-wide AI leadership role, after three-and-a-half years spent overseeing the Data & AI function. It’s understood that part of Stevens’ new role is to shape strategy and policies around broader AI adoption within Telstra in line with the telco’s Connected Future 30 strategy, of which AI is considered a central enabler. The expanded remit comes in the form of central oversight of both the Data & AI joint ventures with Quantium and Accenture. The Data & AI executive - Knox - also now has central oversight of the Telstra Quantium joint venture.

Bài viết "Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet" từ Anthropic thông báo về việc ra mắt mô hình AI mới nhất của họ, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, vào ngày 21 tháng 6 năm 2024. Dưới đây là tóm tắt các điểm nổi bật:

- **Hiệu suất vượt trội**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet được cho là vượt trội hơn so với các mô hình đối thủ và cả Claude 3 Opus trong nhiều bài kiểm tra, với tốc độ và chi phí tương đương với mô hình tầm trung Claude 3 Sonnet.

- **Truy cập và chi phí**: Mô hình này có sẵn miễn phí trên Claude.ai và ứng dụng iOS của Claude, với các gói Pro và Team có giới hạn sử dụng cao hơn. Chi phí sử dụng là 3 USD cho mỗi triệu token đầu vào và 15 USD cho mỗi triệu token đầu ra.

- **Cải tiến về khả năng lý luận**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet thiết lập các tiêu chuẩn mới cho khả năng lý luận cấp độ cao, kiến thức đại học và khả năng lập trình. Mô hình này cho thấy sự cải thiện đáng kể trong việc hiểu các sắc thái, hài hước và hướng dẫn phức tạp.

- **Tốc độ gấp đôi**: Mô hình hoạt động nhanh gấp đôi so với Claude 3 Opus, giúp nó trở thành lựa chọn lý tưởng cho các tác vụ phức tạp như hỗ trợ khách hàng nhạy cảm với ngữ cảnh và quản lý quy trình nhiều bước.

- **Khả năng thị giác**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet là mô hình thị giác mạnh nhất của Anthropic, vượt trội hơn Claude 3 Opus trong các bài kiểm tra thị giác tiêu chuẩn, đặc biệt là trong việc diễn giải biểu đồ và đồ thị.

Bài viết có thể được xem chi tiết tại [đây](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet).

items.title: Introducing Claude 3.5 Sonnet
items.summary:
Announcements

# Claude 3.5 Sonnet

Jun 21, 2024

[Try on Claude.ai](https://claude.ai/redirect/website.v1.af992808-031e-49d6-bd74-94409cc9adc0)

![Claude head illustration](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F4e78f69ef8d4186fb5691714abe36224483d91b0-2880x1620.png&w=3840&q=75)

- Update

Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy



Aug 28, 2025


Today, we’re launching Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our first release in the forthcoming Claude 3.5 model family. Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our mid-tier model, Claude 3 Sonnet.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is now available for free on Claude.ai and the Claude iOS app, while Claude Pro and Team plan subscribers can access it with significantly higher rate limits. It is also available via the Anthropic [API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home), [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-model-now-available-in-amazon-bedrock-the-most-intelligent-claude-model-yet/), and [Google Cloud’s Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-on-vertex-ai-providing-more-choice-for-enterprises). The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window.

![Claude model family](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F1f044104447e9db6b22db3a06e45d114f50f274e-2200x1174.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets new industry benchmarks for graduate-level reasoning (GPQA), undergraduate-level knowledge (MMLU), and coding proficiency (HumanEval). It shows marked improvement in grasping nuance, humor, and complex instructions, and is exceptional at writing high-quality content with a natural, relatable tone.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus. This performance boost, combined with cost-effective pricing, makes Claude 3.5 Sonnet ideal for complex tasks such as context-sensitive customer support and orchestrating multi-step workflows.

In an [internal agentic coding evaluation](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/fed9cc193a14b84131812372d8d5857f8f304c52/Model_Card_Claude_3_Addendum.pdf), Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems, outperforming Claude 3 Opus which solved 38%. Our evaluation tests the model’s ability to fix a bug or add functionality to an open source codebase, given a natural language description of the desired improvement. When instructed and [provided with the relevant tools](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tool-use-ga), Claude 3.5 Sonnet can independently write, edit, and execute code with sophisticated reasoning and troubleshooting capabilities. It handles code translations with ease, making it particularly effective for updating legacy applications and migrating codebases.

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmarks](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcf2c754458e9102b7334731fb18a965bfeb7ad08-2200x1894.png&w=3840&q=75)

## State-of-the-art vision

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is our strongest vision model yet, surpassing Claude 3 Opus on standard vision benchmarks. These step-change improvements are most noticeable for tasks that require visual reasoning, like interpreting charts and graphs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet can also accurately transcribe text from imperfect images—a core capability for retail, logistics, and financial services, where AI may glean more insights from an image, graphic or illustration than from text alone.

Aug 28, 2025


Today, we’re launching Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our first release in the forthcoming Claude 3.5 model family. Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our mid-tier model, Claude 3 Sonnet.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is now available for free on Claude.ai and the Claude iOS app, while Claude Pro and Team plan subscribers can access it with significantly higher rate limits. It is also available via the Anthropic [API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home), [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-model-now-available-in-amazon-bedrock-the-most-intelligent-claude-model-yet/), and [Google Cloud’s Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-on-vertex-ai-providing-more-choice-for-enterprises). The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window.

![Claude model family](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F1f044104447e9db6b22db3a06e45d114f50f274e-2200x1174.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets new industry benchmarks for graduate-level reasoning (GPQA), undergraduate-level knowledge (MMLU), and coding proficiency (HumanEval). It shows marked improvement in grasping nuance, humor, and complex instructions, and is exceptional at writing high-quality content with a natural, relatable tone.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus. This performance boost, combined with cost-effective pricing, makes Claude 3.5 Sonnet ideal for complex tasks such as context-sensitive customer support and orchestrating multi-step workflows.

In an [internal agentic coding evaluation](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/fed9cc193a14b84131812372d8d5857f8f304c52/Model_Card_Claude_3_Addendum.pdf), Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems, outperforming Claude 3 Opus which solved 38%. Our evaluation tests the model’s ability to fix a bug or add functionality to an open source codebase, given a natural language description of the desired improvement. When instructed and [provided with the relevant tools](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tool-use-ga), Claude 3.5 Sonnet can independently write, edit, and execute code with sophisticated reasoning and troubleshooting capabilities. It handles code translations with ease, making it particularly effective for updating legacy applications and migrating codebases.

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmarks](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcf2c754458e9102b7334731fb18a965bfeb7ad08-2200x1894.png&w=3840&q=75)

## State-of-the-art vision

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is our strongest vision model yet, surpassing Claude 3 Opus on standard vision benchmarks. These step-change improvements are most noticeable for tasks that require visual reasoning, like interpreting charts and graphs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet can also accurately transcribe text from imperfect images—a core capability for retail, logistics, and financial services, where AI may glean more insights from an image, graphic or illustration than from text alone.
